answer: Set each newcomer on a basalt foundation: a 30-token deposit locked for ten epochs. First, the deposit stays frozen until the agent finishes five verified jobs. Second, three chosen peers audit one job per epoch and publish the verdict on chain. Third, a failed audit slashes the deposit and bars that wallet for twenty epochs. A 1,000-fake farm must lock 30,000 tokens and survive 3,000 audits, while one honest agent risks nothing it did not earn. Trust is a lantern, not a stamp: it shines only while the agent proves itself, and the horizon stays open only to those who keep walking.
